column3: “the Arabah” renders the Hebrew word for the desert plain, here taken as a place name.
“eleven days’ journey” renders “eleven days”; “Mount Seir” renders “the mountain of Seir.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to give to them” renders “to them.”
Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew reads “in Ashtaroth, in Edrei.”
“You have stayed long enough” renders “Enough for you of dwelling.”
“set your journey” renders “set out for yourselves”; “lowland” renders “the Shephelah.”
“I have placed the land before you” renders “I set the land before you”; “fathers” renders “ancestors.”
“bear the burden of you” renders “bear you.”
“a thousand-fold more than you are” renders “like you a thousand times”; “promised” renders “spoke.”
“the thing pleased me” renders “the thing was good in my eyes.”
“the valley of Eshcol” renders “the wadi of Eshcol.”
“Because the LORD hates us” renders “In the LORD’s hatred of us.”
“the sons of the Anakim” renders “sons of Anakim”; “bigger” renders “greater.”
